Update the spec and agenda with a single concrete contract and note any backend or SDK shape changes it implies.
project_handoffs.reason: The latest discussion is still ambiguous and affects implementation boundaries.
suggested_actions: read docs/design/2026-06-25-schedule-lifecycle-management/spec.md
compare against the Wodnix scheduling behavior
update the agenda and spec with one chosen contract

selected.summary: The ClassKit API and SDK are registered separately in Symphony Hermes and will receive notifications independently.
selected.title: API and SDK now have separate Symphony registrations

selected.summary: The class-kit API and SDK cards were corrected so each assumes no sibling or parent repository exists, carries the full wire contract independently, and can be planned, implemented, and verified using only its own labeled repository. The SDK card uses transport mocks instead of a running backend, and neither card depends on the other.
selected.title: Symphony cards are isolated per repository

selected.summary: Created two Symphony cards in the Planning list: the API card for mutable drafts and immutable publication history, and the SDK card for product-document draft and history manager APIs.
selected.title: Two Symphony cards created in Planning

selected.summary: ClassKit work should be treated as a structural document-lifecycle refactor: one mutable revision-guarded draft per document type/locale, atomic publish into immutable consecutively numbered versions, explicit active version and history, retained published content, SDK draft/history/publish/archive primitives, Noya behind the SDK boundary, and backend contract tests for permissions, conflicts, atomic replacement, and retention.
selected.title: Document lifecycle refactor is the real scope

selected.summary: ClassKit now uses `master` for newly initialized repositories unless a project explicitly says otherwise. The root `class-kit` repo is a local-only documentation repo with no remote origin, `apps/` stays local-only, `class-kit-api` and `class-kit-sdk` track `origin/master`, and duplicate child documentation was removed in favor of the canonical root `docs/` tree.
selected.title: ClassKit defaults new repos to master and keeps root docs canonical

selected.summary: `demo2` is wired to the shared remote Supabase project for local development at `http://localhost:5174`, with `auth_mode=open`, email/password and Google enabled, and the product auth redirect set to `http://localhost:5174`.
selected.title: demo2 remote auth is wired locally

selected.summary: `demo2` should hide the Register CTA for signed-in admin users instead of showing a non-actionable action.
selected.title: Hide demo2 register for admins

selected.summary: `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` should remain present as an empty placeholder in `.env.example`, `supabase/.env.example`, and `supabase/.env`; the real token belongs only in local env or CI secrets.
selected.title: Supabase access token stays as a blank placeholder in env templates

selected.summary: Demo2 dashboard surfaces should follow a drill-down pattern: choose page, then role, then permission category, and edit only the active slice. Future demo2 features should keep that surface-specific shape.
selected.title: Demo2 surfaces should use drill-down editing

selected.summary: `khgs2411@gmail.com` remained a ClassKit platform admin but was removed from `demo2` product membership; platform admins should not be auto-enrolled into a product-local `class_kit.users` row unless explicitly assigned.
selected.title: Platform admins stay outside product-local membership unless assigned
